branded.why: The first Japanese cultured dairy products, out of which Calpis grew: part of the history of milk in Japan.

about.text: Two early Japanese dairy products of the founder of Calpis, both now discontinued: Daigomi, a cultured cream from 1916, and Daigoso, a cultured skimmed milk. Daigoso was first made by accident, when sugar was added to a lactic culture and left overnight, which led to the Calpis process.

sources.text: Daigomi (1916), Daigoso, its discontinuation and the overnight batch, from this article.
